Subject: Fraudulent withdrawals from the Accounts of EPFO through fake cheques-
instructions to avoid fraudulent payment- reg.

Sir,

In order to avoid fraudulent withdrawals due to tampering of cheques and to mitigate
undue hardship to the PF beneficiaries in getting their Provident Fund accumulations, instructions
were issued vide this office circular Nos. (1) Bkg/Fraud/05/18210 dated 22/11/2011, posted at SI.
No. 405 and (2) Bkg/Fraud/05/15614 dated 24/11/2011, posted at SI. No. 408 of the official
website of the organization under Office Orders & Circulars for the year 2011-12.

2. Inspite of the said instructions, the following issues could not be resolved :

a) There is-no facility provided in the Application Software for remitting
provident fund monies in death cases (Form-20) through NEFT.

b) There is no facility provided in the Application Software for remitting
Provident fund monies to the Exempted Trusts through NEFT.

c) Payment of provident fund monies(Form-19) beyond Rs. 1,00,000/-
through NEFT are not possible in the cases where the members
maintain accounts with Co-operative Banks, Regional Rural Banks and
Post Offices,

d

~

Pension payments going through BRS involves amount beyond the limit
Of Rs. 50,000/- and there is no provision in the Application Software for
remitting the same through NEFT.

3. To resolve the above issues, the following instructions were issued vide this office circular
No. Bkg/Fraud/05/39906 dated: 20.12.2011 posted at Sl. No. 460 of the official website of the
organization under Office Orders & Circulars for the year 2011-12:

Page 1 of 2

a) Payment to Exempted Trusts on account of transfer(Form-13) may be made
through Account Payee Demand Draft/Bankers’ Cheque.

b) Payment of Provident Fund to members, in case of Form-19/nominees of the
deceased members in case of Form-20 where amount involved is more than
Rs. 1,00,000/- and where bank accounts of the member/nominees of the
member are in Co-operative Banks and Regional Rural Banks, may be made
through Account Payee Demand Draft/Bankers’ Cheque.

4. Now, the Information Services Division has made further provisions in the Application
Software so that the payments in the cases, cited at Para 3 above, can be made through National
Electronic Fund Transfer(NEFT) except in cases where bank accounts of the member/nominees of
the member are in Co-operative Banks and Regional Rural Banks. There is no need to incorporate
the bank branch addresses in all claims for NEFT Payment. However, verification of IFSC Code,
Account Number, Bank and Bank Branch name should invariably be carried out from cancelled
cheque/photocopy of bank passbook enclosed along with the Claim Form. All these have been taken
care of in the War version 3.2 to all offices issued by IS Division. But payment on account of Form
5(IF) through NEFT has been deferred due to major change in the Application Software.

5. The payment of Provident Fund to members, in case of Form-19/nominees of the deceased
members in case of Form-20, where bank accounts of the member/nominees of the member are in
Co-operative Banks and Regional Rural Banks and amounts involved is upto Rs. 1,00,000/-, shall
continue to be paid through cheques. But Payment beyond Rs. 1,00,000/-,in such cases, shall
continue to be made through Account Payee Demand Draft/Bankers’ Cheque.

6. The Payment of Pension through designated Banks shall continue to be governed by
instructions contained in this office circular No. Bkg/Fraud/05/39906 dated: 20.12.2011 Posted at

SI. No. 460 of the official website of the organization under Office Orders & Circulars for the year
2011-12.

Yours faithfully,
